conflict_axes.name: wear_resistance_vs_post_formability
conflict_axes.description: Hardened acid gold survives daily abrasion but cracks if the piece is worked after plating; soft golds bend but scratch. One deposit cannot maximize both.
poles: hard wear-resistant deposit, form-first only
soft ductile deposit, limited post-forming allowed
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: let the profiled wear class and the recorded form-sequence verdict pick the camp; reorder the workflow (form first) before surrendering wear performance

conflict_axes.name: technical_fit_vs_hazard_readiness
conflict_axes.description: The technically ideal family for a job may sit in a hazard tier the shop cannot lawfully or safely run, pulling selection between deposit quality and shop reality.
poles: select the best-performing chemistry
select only what the shop's readiness classes permit
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: readiness caps the menu before performance is compared; the gap is closed by building readiness deliberately or selecting the compensated lower-tier alternative, never by improvising

conflict_axes.name: throughput_deadline_vs_safety_compliance
conflict_axes.description: Deadlines and batch economics push toward faster families, skipped coupons and rushed gates, directly against the safety and compliance discipline selection exists to enforce.
poles: ship on time at lowest cost
hold every safety and compliance gate
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: safety and compliance beat throughput, cost and deadline in every collision; the schedule moves, the gate does not

conflict_axes.name: hue_richness_vs_karat_honesty
conflict_axes.description: Alloyed flashes deliver the rose, green and champagne hues customers ask for, while lowering the effective karat of the very surface being admired.
poles: deliver the requested hue by alloying
keep the coat's karat story strictly honest
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: deliver the hue and disclose the effective-karat reality together; the claim describes the surface, not the build layer beneath it

conflict_axes.name: gold_capital_vs_architecture_completeness
conflict_axes.description: Every role tank locks more gold and maintenance into the room, so capital argues for fewer tanks while adhesion and hue control argue for the full strike/build/color set.
poles: minimize tanks and locked gold
keep the full role architecture
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: lean the volumes, never the roles: small sacrificial strike, lean color flash, right-sized build — and delete a role only with a mechanism-level justification

conflict_axes.name: cyanide_free_preference_vs_process_capability
conflict_axes.description: The sulfite family's safety appeal collides with its weaker strikes, finite bath life and softer deposit — the honest costs of dropping cyanide.
poles: go cyanide-free for hazard and licensing relief
keep cyanide-route capability for strikes, longevity and wear
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: decide per shop, not per job: a cyanide-unready bench takes sulfite with disciplined prep timing, thickness compensation and bath-life budgeting; a fully-ready shop chooses per job on merit

conflict_axes.name: flash_economy_vs_wear_life
conflict_axes.description: Flash and immersion tiers put real gold color on a piece for minimal gold and effort, but their wear life is measured in months and their thickness can never reach a wear rung.
poles: sell the cheap flash tier
plate to an honest wear class
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the flash tier is legitimate only when sold as flash; any wear expectation in the profile disqualifies immersion and flash selections outright

conflict_axes.name: supplier_system_lockin_vs_best_of_breed
conflict_axes.description: Closed product systems (bath plus paired replenisher plus stabilizer) are safest run whole, but they chain the shop to one supplier's pricing and continuity against the urge to mix components.
poles: stay inside one supplier's closed system per tank
mix components for price or performance
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: never mix within a tank — one product system, one TDS; manage lock-in at selection by choosing suppliers deliberately and requalifying the stack when switching

conflict_axes.name: coupon_rigor_vs_turnaround
conflict_axes.description: The qualifying coupon costs hours and a little gold exactly when the customer wants the piece back tomorrow.
poles: qualify every stack on a coupon first
trust experience and plate the piece directly
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: first-run stacks, changed elements and irreplaceable pieces always get the coupon; genuine repeats may cite their logged qualified history — the customer's piece is never the experiment

conflict_axes.name: nickel_underplate_value_vs_allergy_compliance
conflict_axes.description: Bright nickel is the cheapest route to a leveled premium look under thin gold, and simultaneously the allergen whose release limits regulate skin-contact jewelry.
poles: use bright nickel for leveling and brightness
keep skin-contact stacks nickel-free
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: skin-contact selections take the nickel-free barrier class (palladium-class) or carry a verified release-compliance path per current jurisdiction rules; aesthetics never overrides the flag

edge_cases.description: A stainless-steel piece is selected onto a standard stack and the gold peels in the box because nothing broke the passive film
edge_cases.trigger: passive substrate class enters selection without an activation strike in the stack
edge_cases.mitigation: the substrate map hard-binds passive classes to a Wood's-nickel-class activation strike before any family sign-off; no activation capability, no stainless jobs

edge_cases.description: A hard-gold ring returns for post-plate sizing and the coat microcracks at the stretch, exposing nickel on a skin-contact surface
edge_cases.trigger: post-plate mechanical work performed on a brittle-family deposit
edge_cases.mitigation: the recorded form-first verdict travels with the job so later sizing triggers a strip-and-replate conversation, not silent bench work

edge_cases.description: The shop's best technical answer is an alkaline cyanide system but it has one room, one drain and no monitoring
edge_cases.trigger: cyanide-tier family proposed in a shop failing the readiness class set
edge_cases.mitigation: the family is struck from the menu and the job runs on a compensated sulfite selection or is referred out; readiness is built deliberately or not at all, never improvised

edge_cases.description: A customer orders 'vermeil' on a brass bangle
edge_cases.trigger: a regulated term whose class binds a substrate the job does not have
edge_cases.mitigation: the flag fires at selection: explain the class (sterling silver base plus heavy gold rung), offer honest naming for what brass-based work can be, and record the resolution

edge_cases.description: An immersion 'gold dip' kit is proposed to refresh a daily-worn ring to save tank time
edge_cases.trigger: a wear expectation placed on a self-limiting flash-class system
edge_cases.mitigation: the ceiling mechanism disqualifies the class for any wear rung; the job moves to an electrolytic build selection or the expectation is renegotiated to flash honestly

edge_cases.description: A skin-contact bracelet stack is drafted with bright nickel leveling for the premium look
edge_cases.trigger: nickel underplate meets a prolonged-skin-contact profile
edge_cases.mitigation: the nickel-release flag forces either the palladium-class nickel-free barrier or a verified compliance path per current jurisdiction rules before the record closes

edge_cases.description: A bargain unlabeled 'gold solution' arrives with a job, offered to cut chemistry cost
edge_cases.trigger: a TDS-less solution proposed for a selection
edge_cases.mitigation: refuse at the doctrine level: no TDS means no window, no replenishment scheme and no defensible control; only named commercial products enter the record

edge_cases.description: The qualifying coupon was brass, production is zinc die-cast, and the batch blisters
edge_cases.trigger: coupon substrate class differs from the work's substrate class
edge_cases.mitigation: the coupon rule binds to substrate class, not convenience; die-cast work qualifies on die-cast coupons through the full copper-strike route

edge_cases.description: A glass goblet arrives for gold plating with no interest in a metallization front-end
edge_cases.trigger: non-conductive substrate outside the wet line's reach
edge_cases.mitigation: offer the two honest paths — metallization front-end then electroplate, or referral to the PVD class — and record whichever outcome the customer chooses

edge_cases.description: A rush trade batch tempts the bench to skip the strike and enter the build bath directly
edge_cases.trigger: deadline pressure against the displacement-suppression step
edge_cases.mitigation: the strike is non-negotiable wherever displacement risk exists; the schedule renegotiates, the adhesion mechanism does not

edge_cases.description: One job mixes sterling pieces and mild-steel pieces expected to run as a single lot
edge_cases.trigger: a mixed-substrate batch behind a single stack selection
edge_cases.mitigation: split the lot by substrate class, each with its own recorded stack (silver's migration barrier differs from steel's strike-and-barrier route), and price the split honestly

edge_cases.description: A rose hue approved on last year's coupon reads brassy on this year's pieces after the underplate changed to palladium
edge_cases.trigger: underplate class change beneath a previously approved hue
edge_cases.mitigation: hue is a stack property: any underplate change voids the hue qualification and forces a fresh coupon on the new stack before production

workflow.description: Capture substrate, wear duty, hue and karat target, forming intent, quantity, skin-contact and market context, and customer expectation
workflow.gate: every profile field is filled or explicitly marked unknown-and-blocking

workflow.description: Compare the job's candidate hazard tiers against the shop's verified readiness classes and produce the permitted family menu
workflow.artifact: permitted family menu with readiness verdicts
workflow.gate: cyanide-tier families appear only with segregation, storage, ventilation/monitoring, training and jurisdiction-check classes verified

workflow.description: Confirm each candidate tank maps to a named commercial product with its technical data sheet on file
workflow.artifact: product-and-TDS register for the candidate stack
workflow.gate: no candidate tank lacks a named product and TDS; TDS-less solutions are refused

workflow.description: Choose the thickness/wear class rung the job is plated to, expressed as a marking-class reference
workflow.artifact: declared wear rung with verify-jurisdiction flag
workflow.gate: the rung is consistent with the profiled service duty and named as a class, not a bare number

workflow.description: Map the verified substrate class to its activation, strike and barrier requirements and check the shop can field them
workflow.gate: passive and reactive substrate classes carry their named activation/strike route or the job is refused/referred

workflow.description: Assign strike, build and color roles — present with family and product, or deliberately absent — for this job
workflow.gate: every displacement-risk interface is covered by a strike and hue responsibility sits in a lean tank

workflow.description: Translate the hue target into an alloy direction and flash product with its effective-karat consequence
workflow.artifact: hue target note with alloy mechanism and karat consequence
workflow.gate: the hue names its alloy direction and the karat consequence is stated for the claim chain

workflow.description: Record the form-first or plate-then-form verdict and check it against the candidate families' ductility
workflow.gate: brittle-family selections carry a no-post-forming confirmation; any forming allowance names its soft family and ductile underplate

workflow.description: State each tank's gold-capital mechanism and bath-life class, and check rate-class scheduling against the deadline
workflow.gate: costs appear as mechanisms and classes with no invented figures, and deadline commitments name their first-article verification step

workflow.description: List every regulated-claim class the selection touches and resolve each with its verify-jurisdiction check
workflow.gate: no unresolved flag remains; regulated terms the stack cannot satisfy are removed from the job's language

workflow.description: Write what the selected system may honestly promise and disclose it before authorization
workflow.gate: the promise set matches family, rung and hue mechanism, never represents plated work as solid gold, and states wear as an expectation class

workflow.action: Qualify on coupon and close the record
workflow.description: Run the same-substrate-class coupon through the full stack, then assemble the selection record and hand off
workflow.artifact: qualified coupon result feeding the closed selection record
workflow.gate: the coupon passes adhesion, hue family and measured thickness (or qualified history is cited) and the record carries every required field before production

dominance_rules.rule: Safety and compliance readiness beats throughput, cost and deadline in every family decision
dominance_rules.rationale: an unready shop running cyanide-tier chemistry risks lives and licenses, which no schedule justifies
dominance_rules.trigger: deadline, price or batch pressure argues for a family outside the shop's readiness verdict
dominance_rules.action: hold the menu as gated, renegotiate the schedule or decline the job, and record the pressure and the refusal

dominance_rules.rule: The product TDS beats any remembered, forum-sourced or handbook number for setpoints
dominance_rules.rationale: windows are product-specific; a bath run on someone else's numbers cannot be controlled or defended
dominance_rules.trigger: a setpoint is about to be written or quoted without the specific product's sheet in hand
dominance_rules.action: stop, obtain the TDS, and record windows only by TDS reference or as labeled handbook-class ranges

dominance_rules.rule: Substrate physics beats customer preference on stack requirements
dominance_rules.rationale: displacement deposition and diffusion do not negotiate; a skipped activation or barrier fails regardless of goodwill
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer or deadline requests skipping an activation strike, copper route or barrier the substrate class demands
dominance_rules.action: keep the required stack, explain the mechanism, and refuse or refer the job if the stack cannot be fielded

dominance_rules.rule: The form-sequence verdict beats wear preference when the two collide
dominance_rules.rationale: a brittle coat on a piece that will be worked is a guaranteed failure, while a softer coat is a disclosed trade
dominance_rules.trigger: post-plate forming appears on a job pointed at a hardened family
dominance_rules.action: reorder the workflow to form-first or move the selection to a soft family with disclosed wear consequences

dominance_rules.rule: Honest claim class beats sales pressure everywhere a regulated term appears
dominance_rules.rationale: misusing vermeil, gold-filled or karat language converts a plating job into a legal and reputational liability
dominance_rules.trigger: a request, listing or label uses a term whose class the selection does not satisfy
dominance_rules.action: fire the flag, correct the language or the stack, and close the record only with the resolution documented

dominance_rules.rationale: the strike is the mechanism that makes gold adhere and the shield that keeps the build bath alive; deleting it saves a tank and forfeits both
dominance_rules.trigger: capital or space pressure proposes folding strike duty into the build bath
dominance_rules.action: keep the strike wherever displacement risk exists; lean its volume instead of its existence

dominance_rules.rule: Coupon evidence beats experience for first-run and changed stacks on customer goods
dominance_rules.rationale: familiarity with individual products says nothing about the assembled stack on this substrate
dominance_rules.trigger: a first-run or changed stack is proposed to go straight onto a customer piece
dominance_rules.action: run the same-substrate-class coupon first; the customer's piece is never the experiment

dominance_rules.rule: The commercial-product rule beats ingenuity at every gap
dominance_rules.rationale: self-compounded chemistry has no TDS, no replenisher pairing and no supplier accountability — the failure is unbounded
dominance_rules.trigger: a missing capability tempts mixing raw chemicals or blending incompatible products into a tank
dominance_rules.action: close the gap by purchasing the commercial system or declining the job; never formulate at the bench

dominance_rules.rule: Nickel-release compliance beats bright-nickel aesthetics for skin-contact goods
dominance_rules.rationale: the migration-limit class regulates the allergen the customer wears against skin; leveling beauty does not outrank it
dominance_rules.trigger: a skin-contact profile meets a stack whose leveling plan is bright nickel
dominance_rules.action: switch to the nickel-free barrier class or document a verified compliance path per current jurisdiction rules before the record closes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Complete the job profile — substrate, wear, hue, forming, skin-contact — before naming any family
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-selecting the whole system after a late-discovered profile fact (a sizing plan, an EU customer) invalidates the first choice

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify hazard readiness before quoting or promising a cyanide-tier job
anti_rework_rules.prevents: committed work the shop cannot lawfully run, unwound at the cost of the customer relationship

anti_rework_rules.rule: Obtain the specific product's TDS before any window, time or capability is quoted
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-quoting and re-scheduling when the real product's window contradicts the number promised from memory

anti_rework_rules.rule: Declare the wear rung before comparing families
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering after selection that the chosen family cannot reach the rung economically and starting over

anti_rework_rules.rule: Name the support stack together with the gold family, never afterwards
anti_rework_rules.prevents: adhesion and diffusion failures surfacing in production because the barrier and activation decisions lagged the gold decision

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fire regulated-claim flags at selection, not at labeling time
anti_rework_rules.prevents: relabeling, re-listing or recalling finished goods whose claims the stack never satisfied

anti_rework_rules.rule: Qualify every first-run or changed stack on a same-substrate-class coupon before customer pieces
anti_rework_rules.prevents: strip-and-replate rework on customer goods, the most expensive and trust-destroying failure in the shop

anti_rework_rules.rule: Close the selection record with TDS references and the coupon citation before the first tank entry
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unrepeatable one-off successes and undiagnosable failures that force full re-derivation at every reorder

iteration_protocol.action: reopen the substrate-to-stack mapping and strike pairing, correct, and re-run the coupon before any production

iteration_protocol.trigger: the coupon hue misses the retained reference
iteration_protocol.action: retune the alloy direction, flash product or underplate assumption and requalify on the corrected stack

iteration_protocol.trigger: a supplier revises, discontinues or replaces a product or its TDS
iteration_protocol.action: reopen the affected selections, requalify the changed stack on coupon, and update the records

iteration_protocol.trigger: a jurisdiction changes a marking, karat or nickel-release class the shop sells under
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the compliance flags across open and repeat selections and re-resolve every claim they touch

iteration_protocol.trigger: the job profile changes mid-selection (new wear duty, added forming, changed market)
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the rung, form-sequence and family logic from the changed field forward instead of patching the old selection

iteration_protocol.trigger: the shop's readiness state changes (training lapses or is gained, segregation or monitoring changes)
iteration_protocol.action: re-screen the family menu against the new readiness verdicts and revisit standing selections that relied on the old state

iteration_protocol.trigger: logged bath-life or rate experience contradicts the class assumed at selection
iteration_protocol.action: update the family's economic classes in the selection playbook and re-cost standing repeat jobs

iteration_protocol.trigger: referral volume accumulates in one out-of-scope class (for example non-conductive pieces)
iteration_protocol.action: run a build-versus-refer decision on adding the metallization front-end, and update the boundary record either way

priority_rationale: The frame nodes come first because they gate everything: the job profile defines the problem, the TDS doctrine and hazard gate decide what may lawfully and controllably be run, and the wear ladder fixes the target; the four family nodes then supply the menu those gates filter; architecture, color, support and matching nodes turn a chosen family into a full stack fitted to substrate, hue and forming sequence; the economics and constraint nodes price and legalize the candidate; and the coupon qualification and selection record close last because they convert the chosen stack into verified, repeatable, honestly-promised production work.
